programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 3

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Lamput spends the day at the beach, and, in a pair of swimming trunks, cuts a fine figure indeed. That is to say; a small, round and blobby figure. It only takes one snide comment from a fellow beach-goer to bring Lamput's body issues to the surface. When you're a shape changer, though, there's no need for exercise; before long Lamput is strutting along as an orange amalgam of all the best-looking sunbakers. On the up side, it's a handy disguise when the Docs come a-hunting. On the down side? Well, it's kind of tiring pretending to be someone you're not. Lamput learns an important lesson from a nearby blobby little girl. Be yourself, and if anyone's got a problem with that, they can go find their own patch of sand.

When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.desc: Sometimes Mr. Bean’s Teddy can be no fun at all. Feeling the need for a new friend, Bean buys a parrot. But getting the parrot past his landlady and her one-eyed cat, Scrapper, proves to be no easy task. Next, is trying to get the blasted bird to speak.

And when she sees all the new stones the Baby lemmings have collected, she wants them all back! But the baby lemmings have no intention of stopping their mad marble race through the forest!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1

In a panic, Baby Owl looks for her comforter and tries to get it back from the baby lemmings, but her clumsiness gives them the impression that she wants to harm the comforter! The baby lemmings decide to protect the comforter against all odds!

By simply dusting yourself with its sand, you can fly! It doesn't take Grizzy long to figure this out and the bear rapidly imagines himself as Peter Pan sipping on his easily-harvested coconut milk.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy can't sleep because it's too hot. He decides to confiscate the fans the Lemmings use to power their fake spaceship. Totally into their Space Opera game, the Lemmings try to repel the alien Grizzy with laser party favors and are propelled onto an unknown planet: a volcano crater with a secret base where a rocket is ready to take off. The rocket carries the cabin into space. It's no longer a game: Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to face the dangers of outer space!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

For Grizzy, there's no question that the stock they possessively watch over in an icebox winds up as powder snow!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have discovered a truly wild new game: an augmented reality program on the ranger's digital tablet. programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

Starving, Grizzy decides to melt the ice with the blow-dryer. Only the Lemmings are already using it for their latest rocket game in the piping system.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a box filled with birthday

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Wedged in his sofa to relieve his aching back, Grizzy balks at getting up. He designs clever strategies to do everything from a distance, including confiscating the Lemming's radio-controlled toy robot-transformer which he will use as a butler.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1

Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

The Docs decide that a sleeping potion might be a quick and quiet way of capturing Lamput. Naturally things get out of hand, and when the entire audience catches a whiff of the snoozy brew, we find out exactly how hard it is to stay awake during a classical music recital. One star.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: When Moley finds an old Movie poster about a human hero, Manny's magic conjours up an entire world of action and adventure.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Mona Lisa is hosting an extravagant fashion show and she wants Moley to be the guest of honour, but what will Moley wear for the show?

programme.title: Moley - Season 1

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: A music video of Lola Bunny using her bulldozer to move things as she oversees various looney builds.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2

Ginger screams having just seen a mouse and tells Rick to get Tom out of the moving van. Like most cats in a new place, Tom doesn't want to come out from beneath the recently placed couch, but Ginger demands he catch that mouse! And so we watch the beginning of a lifelong adversarial relationship unfold one gag at a time!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 2

This back and forth continues until the chase takes Tom right past a Singing Uncle Pecos. Tom skids to a stop causing Uncle Pecos to stop singing. Tom wants to prove the lyrics of Uncle Pecos song wrong, but in the end, Tom's ego proves to everyone, including himself, that he is very much the subject of Uncle Pecos cautionary tale.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 1

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 1
programme.desc: Tom eats some canned cheese that has gone bad and hallucinates. He then gets all sorts of visitors from the Tom and Jerry worlds. Tom must become a better cat to end the nightmare.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3

programme.desc: In this country-inspired music video, Buff the Bat-Truck shows off his strength as he tows the bad guys out of town and lifts the spirits of his fellow Batwheels with his sensitive side, all while protecting the people (and critters) of Gotham.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Finally fed up with monsters and mayhem, Shaggy and Scooby decide to quit the gang and train their replacements in one on-the-job training session, unraveling the mystery of a vampire that's terrorizing a small town.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: After a Giant Houndbeast attacks an elite dog show, the gang goes undercover and enters Scooby in the show in order to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Unhappy about a mystery-free, three-day, cross-country train trip with the gang, Fred is pleasantly surprised to discover a monster mystery on board. He's less pleasantly surprised however, when that mystery is interrupted by a second mystery, then a third, then a fourth…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy's last jar of chocolate spread was pinched by the Lemmings, who are savoring it in secret. To localize the Lemmings hiding place, Grizzy trains a raccoon, whose sense of smell equals that of a truffle hound to detect the scent of chocolate spread.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Wedged in his sofa to relieve his aching back, Grizzy balks at getting up. He designs clever strategies to do everything from a distance, including confiscating the Lemming's radio-controlled toy robot-transformer which he will use as a butler.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The vibrations created by Grizzy's snoring during his nap give the Lemmings an idea for a bouncing game. But when Grizzy changes positions and his snoring stops, the Lemmings must find other sources of vibrations. Only these are no longer compatible with Grizzy's nap.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: Skinny might be a man of science, but he’s more than happy to get his fortune told for a laugh. The palm-reader sees alarming visions of Skinny’s near future; mostly visions that relate to Skinny being squashed, smooshed or otherwise smeared. It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Jon, Min, and Miguel can’t wait to explore their new home base! But their welcome party takes a turn when the island’s most feared predator crashes the scene: Big Rex! Uncle Jack ushers them into safety in Dino Explorers HQ! Unbeknown to the ranchers, a duo of rascally compy's have stolen the HQ's system key throwing everything into chaos.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: The Ranchers take the Jungle Jetter on an underwater joyride—but their fun comes to a screeching halt when they catch the eye of Thunderfin, the island’s ill-tempered mosasaurus! With jaws snapping and tail thrashing, Thunderfin charges after them, forcing the kids to dive into the shadows of a nearby cave for cover!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s a beautiful day at the beach. Bean breathes in the salty air, bliss - and not another soul in sight. What could possibly spoil his perfect day? Answer: British weather. Mr. Bean finds himself chasing an illusive ray of sunshine across town, over hills and dales, a football stadium and the English Channel.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose has a passion for little blue mushrooms (which look like a baby lemming lying on its belly), which he searches for like a truffle-hunting dog. But the baby lemmings, after seeing a butterfly disguised as a leaf, decide that day to play hide-and-seek. So when Baby Moose thinks he's going to find some mushrooms, the baby lemmings jump out of their hiding place. Baby Moose gets scared every time and decides to put an end to the baby lemmings' game.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that an ant convoy marching in formation to a berry bush and back can be turned into a fun game of “conveyor belt” for them. However, their irascible neighbor, Baby Beaver, diverts the convoy so that the ants start transporting his sticks for him instead. When Baby Castor loses control of the ants and finds himself in trouble, the Baby Lemmings come to the rescue with an even more fun game!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The baby lemmings are having a picnic but have a nasty tendency to get raspberry juice all over themselves. When one of the baby lemmings dirties baby Raccoon, who has just finished washing up, baby Raccoon decides to take matters into his own hands and wash them. But the baby lemmings get dirty immediately! Baby Raccoon decides to teach them some manners!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Squeaks has a last minute card game at Bugs' house. Bugs is thrilled until con-artist Shifty shows up to ruin the fun.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Yosemite Sam needs a belt so he robs a men's clothing store. Bugs appears to save the day!

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs comes face to face with Jack the Dog Trainer. It's up to him to rescue a pack of dogs.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: A boy bird named Boyd tries to win back his girlfriend through midnight serenade. A desperate-for-sleep Bugs realizes the only way to get him to stop…is to help.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s the middle of the night and Tom plays makeshift instruments creating loud music that wakes up Jerry. Jerry tries to put an end to Tom's concert with no success. Tuffy wakes up and goes along with the music. Jerry decides to join in on the fun.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Fred's worst nightmare comes true when an evil spirit possesses the Mystery Machine and turns his beloved van into an unrelenting monster out to destroy him and the gang before they can solve the mystery.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Daphne brings the gang to a fancy Ice Hotel co-owned by her family where a new exhibit of ice age artifacts is opening. Things heat up, however, when a frozen Ice Man thaws out and goes on a rampage inside the hotel.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst browsing the supermarket for lovely grub, Mr. Bean’s life-long pal, Teddy, is kidnapped. Bean tracks down the nasty men responsible and finds that Teddy is not their only captive. Mr. Bean rescues a hundred teddy bears once their ears are put through an industrial sewing machine.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Jerry is feeling lonely and wishes he had a girlfriend. Spike explains spring fever to Tom and they leave him be. Jerry's mood improves when he gets a message from his brawny cousin Muscles, who has fixed him up with his girlfriend's friend for a double date.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: When Jerry's country cousins visit the Abbey, the cook is convinced Downton is in the midst of a vermin invasion! Cates (the butler) presses Tom into service with the threat of becoming a stable cat otherwise. Tom pursues the cunning, feisty bumpkins, and Jerry, throughout the manor, and they delight in making surprise appearances to Tom in awkward moments.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 3
programme.desc: Jerry discovers the mysterious phobia cats have toward cucumbers and is inspired to try it out on Tom. After freaking Tom out repeatedly, Butch steps in to counsel Tom and help him overcome his fear, only Butch is far from immune himself. The two encounter more and more trouble as they deal with their phobia.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko - Season 1
programme.desc: Jerry and Tuffy go to the Cheese Festival. Tom is cooking in the food truck and turns Jerry into a hotdog. Tom chases after Jerry and Tuffy as they escape.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kid Fury faces Mr. King’s three challenges to prove his worth and show that he is the strongest.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After Kitty the Catmobile saves Bam when he's in a tight spot, Bam decides to take her on a ride along patrol in the hopes of recruiting her as a Batwheel - if he can convince her to stop playing long enough to focus on their mission!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Bibi wishes she could live a rule-free life like Jestah, so she decides to only focus on having fun instead. But when her actions put Batgirl in danger, Bibi must put the fun aside to stop Harley and save her hero.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After he takes down Riddler with an impressive wheel slam move, the Batwheels give Buff the nickname Tough Buff. But Buff abruptly bristles at the name, leading the Batwheels to realize that it's not okay to call your friends nicknames that they don't like.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: After being zapped by Penguin's Songinator ray, the Batwheels find themselves only able to communicate through song! They'll need to learn to harmonize as a team to defeat the musical prankster.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Taz’s birthday, so The Looney Builders build him a huge ice cream sundae. Porky worries about making a mistake and delays the build causing the ice cream to start to melt.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders race against the clock to build Cecil Turtle a new racetrack. Daffy gets caught up in his own desire to race and changes part of the build.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: George P. Mandrake hires The Looney Builders to build a T. Rex fossil. It’s Tweety’s job to place the bones with his crane, but his fear of the big dino affects his ability to get the job done.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Pauleen Penguin hires The Looney Builders to build her a home in Looneyburg. Lola soon discovers they got the design wrong and the crew has to make adjustments.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Halloween, so the crew decorates their garage for the Looneyburg Trick-Or-Treaters.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mistaken for an escaped convict, Bean is carted off to jail where he finds that, with a little imagination, prison can be quite nice actually. The real convict finds life less cosy under the thumb of Mr. Bean’s landlady.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself dogged by a young Japanese boy at the Science Museum. He takes an instant dislike to the Scallywag until he sees what the kid has in his backpack: gadgets so cool you can’t even get them in the West. So when a security guard tries to ruin their fun they run away together to... Mars!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are enjoying a day at the arcade, when Mr Bean gets carried away with the dance machine, knocking Teddy onto the floor. Teddy’s picked up, put on a trolley of stuffed toys and figurines – and soon enough, he’s been put in the claw machine as a prize! Mr Bean has run out of coins, so has to find a way of winning Teddy back without looking like he’s cheating!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet – but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless – he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm – yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to give the she-bear he's in love with a plastic ring which he finds really swell. But since the object was found in the trash, he needs to wash it first. And the Lemmings are using the sole bar of soap in the house as a bobsleigh.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a strange American Indian figurine with the power to switch the spirits of two living beings and finds himself imprisoned in the body of a caribou. He immediately tries to activate the reverse procedure, but the Lemmings steal the figurine in order to turn into a partridge and fly away.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: While salmon fishing on the riverbank, Grizzy hauls in an unusual catch: an old hand mirror straight out of a fairytale. Instead of showing the reflection of the person who holds it, the mirror shows an idealized vision of his surroundings. Whether it be Grizzy or the Lemmings, everyone sees the world of his dreams, and no one wants to share it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: In a casing that fell from a circus caravan, the Lemmings find a magic stick that can enchant objects and make them come alive. Grizzy is sure that a stick like that would save him a lot of work, the only problem is how to get it from the Lemmings, who have become sorcerer's apprentices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Whilst trying to stop the Lemmings from playing with a crate of firework rockets, Grizzy is literally carried away with them when the largest specimen shoots off. When the entire crate of fireworks explodes with a boom, they are hurled out of the atmosphere and all the way to the moon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: With their endless battles over the ranger's cabin which they do not want to share, Grizzy and the Lemmings end up blowing the cabin up. Amidst the debris, they discover a strange pack: an army tent with all the necessary equipment to recreate a home in nature. It's the chance to discover the joys of camping in the wild.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings encounter a white bear which has drifted all the way to them on a chunk of ice which is slowly melting. The bear makes a fabulous rodeo partner, he just needs enough ice to keep cool. Even a few ice cubes on his head are enough. The only obstacle to this beautiful friendship is Grizzy, who considers himself master of the fridge and thus of the cabin's ice production.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy gets rid of the Lemmings by crushing them with one of the ranger's heavy trunks, which he immediately clears out of the cabin, his enemies stuck to it like stickers. What he doesn't know, is that the trunk contains a multifunction drone, complete with joystick and virtual reality headset, which enables embedded piloting. Thanks to this cutting-edge technology, the Lemmings decide to regain control of the situation!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a strange pond in an American Indian grotto that has the power to rejuvenate anyone who dips in it. They spray a bit of the water of youth onto Grizzy and he instantly turns into a harmless cub they can easily rid themselves of. But the effects of the waters are only temporary.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Before taking a nap, Grizzy locks the food cupboard to prevent the Lemmings from getting into it. And to be sure they cannot force the lock, Grizzy throws all the house tools into the ravine. The Lemmings find a crate of mini building-blocks which enables them to build a hammer... and any other object they wish!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings happen on a native American Indian burial place under the ranger's cabin. When they accidentally activate a magic disk representing the earth, they are sent back in time to the prehistoric era...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a phial containing a love potion: anyone who drinks it immediately falls in love with the first creature he sees. Grizzy already imagines himself becoming irresistible in the eyes of his beloved she-bear. But that is without taking into account the Lemmings... clumsiness, and their rodeo caribou drinking the magic potion.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings notice that Grizzy moves away from the jar of chocolate spread whenever he chases the fly buzzing around him. But the insect can never hold out long enough for the Lemmings to swipe the jar before being knocked out. They decide to give the fly intensive sports training.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the ranger's collection of bird calls by chance. With a simple blow of the whistle, he can attract a flock of partridges that are at his beck and call. For Grizzy, it's a super-practical way of being waited on by feathered servants, while the Lemmings see it as a golden opportunity to have a squadron which obeys at the drop of a dime.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: While fighting over a jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings set off a chain reaction which sends the jar flying into space, where it damages the space station. Amongst the debris that falls in front of the cabin, the Lemmings discover a box that cancels out gravity.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night – but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish – and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport – she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure – a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: The Docs prove their inventing skills by coming up with an age-altering time-ray. This breakthrough could change the world. If they used it for something other than chasing Lamput. Obsessed much, fellas? Wildly shooting their time-ray off in public causes a not-unsurprising amount of chaos, until the local law enforcement gets caught in the cross-fire. Looks like the Specs and Skinny are gonna be in jail till they get old the normal way.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: MoleTown has a spectacular fun fair and at its heart is a huge ferris wheel created by Mishmosh, but after Manny speeds things up, Moley has to save the day.

programme.title: Moley - Season 1
programme.desc: Mrs Moley is directing a small play, with Moley cast as the hero, but his fear gets the better of him and so Manny conjures up a spell which turns all residents into their characters, now Moley must save them for real.

programme.title: Vientuļā dzērusī sieviete
programme.desc: Semas jaunatklātā pašapziņa tiek satricināta - viņa uzzina, ka viņas jaunais priekšnieks ir pagātnes rēgs. Tikmēr Felīcija kļūdās, apsveicot savu draugu ar viņa paaugstināšanu amatā. Un Olīvija pieņem dzīvi mainošu lēmumu.

programme.title: Noziegums kuru atcerēties
programme.desc: Losandželosa, 1922. gads. Tiek atrasts miris vīrs, un viņa sieva atrasta ieslodzīta skapī. Izmeklētāji procesā apmaldās pakļaušanas un apsēstības pasaulē, kur spoki ir vairāk nekā īsti.

programme.title: Algota slepkavība
programme.desc: Greizsirdība un apsēstība sasniedz kulmināciju - īpašniecisks narcissists ratiņkrēslā izstrādā metodisku plānu nogalināt savu neko nenojaušošo bijušo draudzeni.

programme.title: Pirmās 48
programme.desc: Alabamas štata Mobilā 21 gadu vecu sievieti viesnīcas numuriņā nošauj noslēpumains apmeklētājs. 42 gadus vecs mūzikas producents atrasts Gvinetas apgabala dzīvoklī sašauts. Pazīmes liecina par ārprātīgu vīrieti, kas ir iesaistīts apšaudē.

programme.title: Dino Dana
programme.desc: Dana on innukas 10-aastane tüdruk, kes armastab dinosauruseid. Kohe nii väga, et isa valmistas talle erilise seljakoti, mille abil ta saab muutuda ükskõik milliseks dinosauruseks. Ees ootavad vägevad dinoseiklused!

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Andy eelajaloolised seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab muuseumis ning tema kasutada on ajamasin, mis viib ta tagasi eelajaloolisse aega, et ta saaks sealt kaasa tuua sulgi, luid ja kõike muud, mida muuseumi ekspositsioon vajab. Tänu oma seljakotis olevatele vajalikele abivahenditele jõuab ta alati ohutult tänapäeva muuseumi tagasi.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Andy seiklused dinosaurustega
programme.desc: Muuseumis töötav Andy avastab salajase portaali, mis viib ta dinosauruste aega tagasi.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Meister igal alal
programme.desc: Kümme noorsportlast osalevad ülimal spordivõistlusel. Trikk on aga selles, et nad ei võistle oma spordialadel, vaid teiste võistlejate aladel. Võistluse lõpus enim punkte kogunud sportlane pälvib tiitli Meister igal alal.

programme.title: Lahedad loomad
programme.desc: Alates surfavatest hiirtest ja maalivatest koertest kuni rääkivate hobuste ning trühvlisigadeni. Kõige kavalamad, nunnumad ja pöörasemad loomad.

programme.title: Andy safari seiklused
programme.desc: Andy töötab Safari maailmas, kogu Maakera kõige suuremas ja paremas looduspargis koos oma ülemuse, härra Hammondi ja tehnikavõluri Jeniga. Mistahes huvitav ülesanne teda ees ka ei ootaks, kihutab Andy oma safari-autoga kohale.

programme.title: Ajuvabalt palju küsimusi
programme.desc: Keni aju esitab muudkui uusi huvitavaid küsimusi: Kas on võimalik end kuule katapulteerida? Kas koerad suudavad rääkida? Mis juhtuks, kui kogu maailm tuleks sinu juurde teed jooma? Õnneks aitab tema sõber Leila nendele küsimustele vastused leida.

programme.title: Andy veeseiklused
programme.desc: Andy naaseb vaimustavate veeseiklustega. Avasta temaga koos veekogusid üle kogu maakera ning kohtu delfiinide, vaalade ja muude hämmastavate loomadega.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed

programme.title: Kotrynos burtai
programme.desc: Maisto tinklaraštininkė, nuomonės formuotoja, knygų autorė Kotryna Starkienė imsis užduoties ruošti patiekalus iš sezoninių produktų, savo sodyboje Dzūkijoje užaugintų daržovių, surinktų uogų, grybų ar iš vietinių augintojų pirktos mėsos. Kotryna gamins tiek kasdienius, kiekvienam lengvai paruošiamus patiekalus, tiek šventinius, skirtus specialioms progoms, nepamiršdama desertų. Laidoje bus ir buitinių patarimų – kaip paprasčiausiai išvalyti skalbimo mašiną, kaip padaryti, kad medinės pjaustymo lentelės vėl atrodytų, kaip naujos, kaip išlyginti staltiesę, kai neturite lygintuvo.

programme.title: Svajonių sodai
programme.desc: Naujajame „Svajonių sodų sezone kviečiame žiūrovus į nepakartojamą kelionę po gražiausius Europos sodus ir parkus. Laidos žiūrovai bus supažindinti ne tik su garsiais botanikos sodais ir istoriniais parkais, bet ir privačių želdintojų kūriniais, kurie paprastai neprieinami plačiajai visuomenei. Žiūrovai turės galimybę pamatyti šiuos gamtos šedevrus skirtingais metų laikais – nuo pavasario žydėjimo ir vasaros žalumos iki rudens spalvų žaismo. Kiekviena laida atskleis unikalias sodininkystės tradicijas ir inovatyvius kraštovaizdžio sprendimus. Tai bus tikra šventė visų gamtos mylėtojų akims ir širdims.

programme.title: Bruto ir Neto
programme.desc: Serialas žiūrovus vėl nukels į įprastą lietuvišką kaimą, kuriame dedasi visai neįprasti dalykai. Keršto vedamas aktoriaus Vaidoto Martinaičio vaidinamas Pranas mintimis grįš į laikus, kai bandydamas atsisakyti alkoholio apsigyveno arabų kraštuose. Būdamas šiltuose kraštuose Pranas išmoko maisto gaminimo paslapčių, todėl nuspręs Gaisrių kaime atidaryti restoraną, susilauksiantį neregėto populiarumo. Tačiau pagrindinis Prano tikslas bus pasipriešinti konkurentams – naujai hipsterių porai, kurių vaidmenis atliks aktoriai Karina Stungytė ir Eimutis Kvosčiauskas. Naujajame serialo sezone – ne tik įspūdinga Prano priešistorė ir netikėta sėkmė. Serialo ašimi tampa linksmieji Bruto bei Neto, kuriuos negailestingos gyvenimo aplinkybės ir vėl atbloškia į nuošaliausią Lietuvos vietą. Nutrūktagalviai draugai vis atsiduria iki ašarų juoktis verčiančiose situacijose, iš kurių išsisukti – beveik neįmanoma. Seriale pagrindinius vaidmenis ir toliau kuria aktoriai Šarūnas Banevičius ir Jonas Gricius, Vaidotas Martinaitis, Asta Baukutė ir kiti. Šiame sezone taip pat bus galima išvysti kitus žymius aktorius bei garsenybes – Inetą Stasiulytę, Vaidą Baumilą, Valdą Burnį, Rafailą Karpį, Viktoriją Šaulytę.

programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: Naujojo TV3 sezono „Mano TV3. Gera kartu!“ premjera – lietuviškas serialas „Moterų laimė“ yra kuriamas pagal visame pasaulyje didžiulio populiarumo sulaukusį daugiaserijinį filmą. Pastarasis yra rodomas daugiau nei penkiasdešimtyje pasaulio šalių, tarp kurių – Rusija, JAV, Kanada, Indija, Meksika, o serialo žiūrimumas svetur – rekordiškas didelis. Pagrindiniais smuikais seriale griežia penkios gražios, stiprios ir labai skirtingos herojės, kurias jungs bendras darbas, draugystė ir bėdos. „Stiprios moterys verkia tyliai... Rytoj bus geriau!“ – tokiu požiūriu gyvenimo negandas pasitiks serialo veikėjos. Autentiškas, dramatiškas ir pamokančias gyvenimo istorijas perteiks talentingos Lietuvos aktorės – Gabija Ryškuvienė, Daiva Tamošiūnaitė, Vaida Būtytė, Goda Petkutė bei Akvilina Ubartaitė. „Moterų laimės“ herojės – sostinėje gyvenančios keturios moterys. Visos jos – labai skirtingos. Skirtingi jų siekiai ir ieškojimai. Viena mėgina tapti laiminga, kita ieško meilės, trečia pradeda lipti karjeros laiptais, ketvirta visomis keturiomis kabinasi į gyvenimą. Šitame kelyje – daugybė kliūčių, kurias moterims teks įveikti. Penktoji, pagrindinė herojė patirs ir praradimo skausmą ir netikėto atradimo džiaugsmą.

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.

programme.title: Kotrynos burtai
programme.desc: Maisto tinklaraštininkė, nuomonės formuotoja, knygų autorė Kotryna Starkienė imsis užduoties ruošti patiekalus iš sezoninių produktų, savo sodyboje Dzūkijoje užaugintų daržovių, surinktų uogų, grybų ar iš vietinių augintojų pirktos mėsos. Kotryna gamins tiek kasdienius, kiekvienam lengvai paruošiamus patiekalus, tiek šventinius, skirtus specialioms progoms, nepamiršdama desertų. Laidoje bus ir buitinių patarimų – kaip paprasčiausiai išvalyti skalbimo mašiną, kaip padaryti, kad medinės pjaustymo lentelės vėl atrodytų, kaip naujos, kaip išlyginti staltiesę, kai neturite lygintuvo.

programme.title: Svajonių sodai
programme.desc: Naujajame „Svajonių sodų sezone kviečiame žiūrovus į nepakartojamą kelionę po gražiausius Europos sodus ir parkus. Laidos žiūrovai bus supažindinti ne tik su garsiais botanikos sodais ir istoriniais parkais, bet ir privačių želdintojų kūriniais, kurie paprastai neprieinami plačiajai visuomenei. Žiūrovai turės galimybę pamatyti šiuos gamtos šedevrus skirtingais metų laikais – nuo pavasario žydėjimo ir vasaros žalumos iki rudens spalvų žaismo. Kiekviena laida atskleis unikalias sodininkystės tradicijas ir inovatyvius kraštovaizdžio sprendimus. Tai bus tikra šventė visų gamtos mylėtojų akims ir širdims.

programme.title: Bruto ir Neto
programme.desc: Serialas žiūrovus vėl nukels į įprastą lietuvišką kaimą, kuriame dedasi visai neįprasti dalykai. Keršto vedamas aktoriaus Vaidoto Martinaičio vaidinamas Pranas mintimis grįš į laikus, kai bandydamas atsisakyti alkoholio apsigyveno arabų kraštuose. Būdamas šiltuose kraštuose Pranas išmoko maisto gaminimo paslapčių, todėl nuspręs Gaisrių kaime atidaryti restoraną, susilauksiantį neregėto populiarumo. Tačiau pagrindinis Prano tikslas bus pasipriešinti konkurentams – naujai hipsterių porai, kurių vaidmenis atliks aktoriai Karina Stungytė ir Eimutis Kvosčiauskas. Naujajame serialo sezone – ne tik įspūdinga Prano priešistorė ir netikėta sėkmė. Serialo ašimi tampa linksmieji Bruto bei Neto, kuriuos negailestingos gyvenimo aplinkybės ir vėl atbloškia į nuošaliausią Lietuvos vietą. Nutrūktagalviai draugai vis atsiduria iki ašarų juoktis verčiančiose situacijose, iš kurių išsisukti – beveik neįmanoma. Seriale pagrindinius vaidmenis ir toliau kuria aktoriai Šarūnas Banevičius ir Jonas Gricius, Vaidotas Martinaitis, Asta Baukutė ir kiti. Šiame sezone taip pat bus galima išvysti kitus žymius aktorius bei garsenybes – Inetą Stasiulytę, Vaidą Baumilą, Valdą Burnį, Rafailą Karpį, Viktoriją Šaulytę.

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou

programme.title: Moterų laimė
programme.desc: Naujojo TV3 sezono „Mano TV3. Gera kartu!“ premjera – lietuviškas serialas „Moterų laimė“ yra kuriamas pagal visame pasaulyje didžiulio populiarumo sulaukusį daugiaserijinį filmą. Pastarasis yra rodomas daugiau nei penkiasdešimtyje pasaulio šalių, tarp kurių – Rusija, JAV, Kanada, Indija, Meksika, o serialo žiūrimumas svetur – rekordiškas didelis. Pagrindiniais smuikais seriale griežia penkios gražios, stiprios ir labai skirtingos herojės, kurias jungs bendras darbas, draugystė ir bėdos. „Stiprios moterys verkia tyliai... Rytoj bus geriau!“ – tokiu požiūriu gyvenimo negandas pasitiks serialo veikėjos. Autentiškas, dramatiškas ir pamokančias gyvenimo istorijas perteiks talentingos Lietuvos aktorės – Gabija Ryškuvienė, Daiva Tamošiūnaitė, Vaida Būtytė, Goda Petkutė bei Akvilina Ubartaitė. „Moterų laimės“ herojės – sostinėje gyvenančios keturios moterys. Visos jos – labai skirtingos. Skirtingi jų siekiai ir ieškojimai. Viena mėgina tapti laiminga, kita ieško meilės, trečia pradeda lipti karjeros laiptais, ketvirta visomis keturiomis kabinasi į gyvenimą. Šitame kelyje – daugybė kliūčių, kurias moterims teks įveikti. Penktoji, pagrindinė herojė patirs ir praradimo skausmą ir netikėto atradimo džiaugsmą.
